correctness.rationale: Complete real-number argument: hypercube Walsh spectra give exact PBH lower bound; the rank-incidence commutator proves injections between lower Hamming shells; complement parity and adjacency recurrence prove the central slice is a uniqueness set for any odd-cube eigenvector. For an even cube, restriction to one facet splits into Walsh degrees k and k-1; two complementary middle face shells separate these components and the odd result kills both. The eigen-equation then kills the opposite facet. Both constructed sizes equal the maximum multiplicity. Two-field exact modular replay tested 130 spectral restriction ranks and 10 direct Kalman ranks, only for finite dimensions.

value.rationale: A natural exponential graph family is given a complete constructive vertex-specific optimal actuator placement, with no numerical search. Unlike an abstract multiplicity count, the theorem identifies actual nodes achieving PBH simultaneously for every spectral mode, splits the geometry correctly by parity, and establishes a sharp eigenfunction uniqueness principle. It shows the minimum controllable fraction is asymptotic to sqrt(2/(pi*d)), useful for interpreting scalable distributed control.
